questions.prompt_html: \text{设 } A, B \text{ 是任意两个事件，则 } P( A - B ) = ( ) \, .

questions.analysis_html: \text{根据概率的性质有：} \ P(A-B)=P(A)-P(AB)\,.

questions.prompt_html: \text{已知}P(B)>0, A_{1}A_{2}=\varnothing, \text{则下列各式不正确的是( ).}

options.label: A
options.html: \overline{P(A_{1}\overline{A_{2}}|B)} = 1

options.label: B

options.label: C

options.label: D
options.html: P(\overline{A_{1}}\cup \overline{A_{2}}|B) = 1

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{由于 }A_1A_3=\varnothing,\text{则}P(A_1\cup A_3|B)=P(A_1|B)+P(A_3|B)\,,\,\,\,P(A_1A_3|B)=0,\\&\text{又由于}\overline{A_1A_2}=\overline{A_1}\cup \overline{A_2},\,\,\overline{A_1\cup A_2}=\overline{A_1A_2},\\&\text{所以}P(\overline{A_1\cup A_3}|B)=1\,,\,\,\text{且}1-P(\overline{A_1A_2}B)=P(A_1\cup A_2|B)\text{可以不等于零.故}P(\overline{A_1A_2}|B)=1\text{不正确.}\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \text{下列结论中，错误的是( )}.

options.label: A
options.html: \text{若 } P( A ) = 0 , \text{则 } A \text{为不可能事件}

options.label: B
options.html: \begin{array}{l} P (A) + P (B) \geq P (A \cup B) \end{array}

options.label: C
options.html: P(B-A) \geq P(B) - P(A)

options.label: D
options.html: P(B-A) = P(B) - P(BA)

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&A=\varnothing \Rightarrow P(A)=0,\text{但反之不成立}.\\&\text{根据概率性质}P(A\cup B)=P(A)+P(B)-P(AB)\leq P(A)+P(B),\\&\text{由概率性质}P(B-A)=P(B)-P(BA),\text{因为}AB\subset A,\text{所以}P(AB)\leq P(A),\text{则有}P(B-A)\geq P(B)-P(A)\text{正确}.\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \text{设当事件}A,B \text{同时发生时必导致事件}C \text{发生，则}().

options.label: A
options.html: P(C) \geq P(A) + P(B) - 1

options.label: B
options.html: P(AB) = P(C)

options.label: C
options.html: P(AB) \geq P(C)

options.label: D
options.html: P(C) \leq P(A) + P(B) - 1

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{由条件概率公式及题目条件 }P(C|AB)=1 \text{得 }P(ABC)=P(AB).\\&\text{根据概率性质 }P(A\cup B)=P(A)+P(B)-P(AB), \text{则 }P(AB)=P(A)+P(B)-P(A\cup B),\\&\text{由于 }ABC\subseteq C, P(A\cup B)\leq 1, \text{所以 }P(C)\geq P(ABC)=P(AB)=P(A)+P(B)-P(A\cup B)\geq P(A)+P(B)-1.\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \text{已知} A \subset B \text{，则} P(B-A)=()\text{.}

options.label: A
options.html: P(B) - P(A)

options.label: D

questions.analysis_html: \text{由概率的性质可知，若} \, A \subset B \, , \, \text{则} \, P(B-A) = P(B) - P(A) \, .

questions.prompt_html: \text{已知：三个事件}A_{1},A_{2},A_{3} \text{都满足}A_{i}\subset A(i=1,2,3), \text{下列说法正确的是( ).}

options.label: A
options.html: \begin{aligned}P(A) \geq P(A_1) + P(A_2) + P(A_3) - 2\end{aligned}

options.label: B
options.html: \begin{array}{l} P (A) \geq P (A _ {1}) + P (A _ {2}) + P (A _ {3}) \end{array}

options.label: C
options.html: P(A) < P(A_{1}) + P(A_{2})

options.label: D
options.html: \begin{aligned}P(A) \geq P(A_1) + P(A_2)\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} \text{因为 } A_i \subset& A(i=1,\,2,\,3),\,\,\text{所以 } A_1A_2A_3 \subset A,\,\,\text{于是} \\ P(A) &\geq P(A_1A_2A_3)\,\geq P(A_1A_2A_3)+P(A_3)-P(A_1A_2\cup A_3) \\ &\geq P(A_1A_2)+P(A_3)-1, \\ \text{同理} \quad\quad P(A_1A_3) &= P(A_1)+P(A_3)-P(A_1\cup A_3) \\ &\geq P(A_1)+P(A_3)-1, \\ \text{综上得到} \quad\quad P(A) &\geq P(A_1)+P(A_2)+P(A_3)-2.\,\,\text{证毕}. \\ \text{另证：} &\because A_i \subset A \\ &\therefore P(A_i)\leq P(A) \\ \text{又} &\because P(A_i)\leq 1 \\ &\therefore P(A) \geq P(A_1)+P(A_2)+P(A_3)-2.\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \text{随机事件} \, A , B \text{满足} \, B \subset A \text{，则以下各式错误的是( )}.

options.label: A
options.html: P(B|A) = P(B)

options.label: B
options.html: P(A \cup B) = P(A)

options.label: C
options.html: \begin{array}{l} { r } { P ( \overline { { A } } \, \overline { { B } } ) = P ( \overline { { A } } ) } \end{array}

options.label: D
options.html: P(B) \leq P(A)

questions.analysis_html: \begin{array}{l} \text {由} B \subset A, \text {可知} A \cup B = A, \; AB = B, \; P(B) \leq P(A), \\ \text {所以} P(A \cup B) = P(A), \; P(\overline{AB}) = P(\overline{A \cup B}) = P(\overline{A}), \\ \text {只有} P(B|A) = P(B) \text {不正确，因为} P(B|A) = \frac{P(AB)}{P(A)} = \frac{P(B)}{P(A)} \geq P(B). \end{array}

options.label: D

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{由已知}P((A_1+A_2)B)=P(A_1\,B)+P(A_2\,|B),\\&\text{将等式两边都乘以}P(B),\text{分别有}\\&P(B)P((A_1+A_2)|B)=P((A_1+A_2)B)=P(A_1B+A_2B),\\&P(B)[P(A_1|B)+P(A_2|B)]=P(B)P(A_1\,B)+P(B)P(A_2\,|B)=P(A_1B)+P(A_2B),\\&\text{所以,}P(A_1B+A_2B)=P(A_1B)+P(A_2B).\\&\text{注：}\ A_1B\cap A_2B=\varnothing \Rightarrow A_1\cap A_2=\varnothing\,.\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{由条件概率公式及题目条件 }P(C|AB)=1\text{ 得 }P(ABC)=P(AB).\\&\text{由选项可以看出主要考虑 }P(C)\text{ 与 }P(A\cup B)\text{ 的大小关系，可以根据概率性质 }P(A\cup B)=P(A)+P(B)-P(AB),\text{ 则 }\\&P(AB)=P(A)+P(B)-P(A\cup B),\\&\text{由于 }ABC\subset C, P(A\cup B)\leq 1, \text{ 所以 }P(C)\geq P(ABC)=P(AB)=P(A)+P(B)-P(A\cup B)\geq P(A)+P(B)-1,\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} \text{设池内有 } n \text{ 条鱼，则从池中捉到一条有记号鱼的概率为 }\frac{100}{n}, \\ \text{它近似于捉到有记号鱼的频率 }\frac{2}{40}, \\ \text{即} \quad \frac{100}{n} \approx \frac{2}{40} \Rightarrow n \approx 2000, \\ \text{故池内大约有 } 2000 \text{ 条鱼.} \end{aligned}
